OAT-06/S15.title: General feedback from Settings in both contexts: stored with rating and comment, independent of the other surveys
OAT-06/S15.detail: Local QA stack only (round-companion-wt-qa at main 43c38a4f, the build dev runs); brand-new @roundai.test accounts; survey, usage and patient-activity rows read with the local admin key; no model call from these specs (the Convex socket answers generateHandoff in the browser and refuses every other ai/* action; tripwire: no Generate). Re-run on 43c38a4f because #86 moved the form into FeedbackForm.tsx (shared with the 4 PM card). Settings opened from the Hospital list's bottom nav: Rate 2 + 'QA OAT-06 feedback: dictation is slow on hospital Wi-Fi.' -> Send feedback; Settings closed, Nursing Home toggle, Settings from that list (it shows 'Nursing Home Note Templates'), the box empty again, Rate 5, no comment -> Send feedback. Judged 4/4: 'Thanks — your feedback was sent.' after each send; exactly two surveyResponses rows since T0, survey 'feedback': {rating 2, comment = the typed text} and {rating 5} with no comment key; no baseline, handoff_followup or task_reminder row and no Not now on record (the baseline card on the list was left untouched); no model call. Recorded: both rows carry the day and only rating / comment; a Settings send is on record as the day's feedback (status feedback.answeredAt), so the 4 PM card stays away for the rest of that day; the baseline stays due.
